messages:
Maria: quick heads-up - hit a reproducible stale-read after a local write to a prefix. read returned pre-write data for ~10-30ms under load.
Ken: yep that's the eviction/residency propagation gap we've feared. async residency updates + background compactions mean other nodes may still route to an old slab briefly.
Alex: saw this pattern in our chaos runs. two pragmatic mitigations: (1) short-duration write-held pin on the prefix (guard N ms), (2) best-effort read-repair that checks a recent write-log before returning. both trade memory for consistency.
Maria: proposal: add an opt-in write flag `touch_on_write_ttl_ms`. when set, write increments prefix refcount and schedules a delayed decrement. default off.
Deploy-bot: note: feature-flag path exists: `/flags/runtime/prefix_touch_on_write` (can gate per-tenant).
Tara: worried about amplification: lots of tiny writes could inflate pinned bytes and cause eviction pressure. what caps do we enforce?
Alex: enforce `pinned_bytes_per_node` and `pinned_prefix_count_limit`. keep TTL conservative (25-200ms) and apply probabilistic sampling for small payloads. emit metrics: pinned_payload_bytes, pinned_prefix_count, pinned_eviction_pressure.
Ken: rollout: start Dedicated-only opt-in customers; canary to a few teams with latency-sensitive workloads. add alerting rule if pinned_bytes > 90th percentile baseline. metrics to add: `evict_after_write`, `read_repair_hit_rate`.
Maria: impl sketch: reuse prefix refcount table (no new store). write flow: `increment_ref(prefix)`, `persist_write()`, `schedule_timer(ttl_ms, decrement_ref)`. add percent-jitter to timers to avoid synchronized churn. tests: simulate write->read windows 0-200ms and assert visibility.
Alex: also add lightweight in-process recent-write cache (LRU) for reads that miss residency; consult this cache for strict reads in <10ms windows instead of pinning when memory budget is tight. prefer pin as the primary path.
Jordan: product question: what's the hosted default? opt-in only?
Ken: recommend hosted default OFF (opt-in via Console toggle per-tenant). Dedicated customers can enable via tenant config. Console should show recommended TTL and estimated memory impact.
Tara: can we add an adaptive fallback: when node memory > threshold, auto-disable write-touch for new writes and record a counter?
Maria: yes. add `touch_backoff` signal: if pinned_ratio > X then stop taking new touch_on_write pins for 1s and log a `touch_backoff_event`.
Alex: also consider a hybrid: sample 1/N writes to pin for micro-consistency and rely on read-repair for the rest; reduces steady-state pinned bytes.
Ken: telemetry: add histograms for pin durations, per-tenant pinned bytes, read-latency-with-pin vs without. add dashboards and an SLO checklist for canary.
Maria: action items: I'll open an RFC (API, flags, metrics, tests, canary plan). owners: Alex (implementation), Ken (telemetry + rollout), Maria (RFC + coordination). I'll link the RFC here once created. :thumbsup:
